description: Find browser games by player preferences. Returns at most 10 (default 3) ranked games with direct play links, match reasons and evidence labels. Strict filters never accept unknown facts; check "shortage" when fewer games match than requested.

art_styles.description: Match games having ANY of these graphics styles (pixel = retro/pixel art, vector = flat/minimalist, hand_drawn = artsy/painterly). Inferred from screenshots.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

devices.description: Game must work on ALL of these devices. Use ["mobile"] for "works on my phone".

free_to_start.description: true = only games known to be free or free to start.

genres.description: Match games having ANY of these genres.

include_unknown.description: true = also return games whose filtered facts are UNKNOWN, as a separate labelled list. They never count as matches.

inputs.description: Game must support ALL of these input methods.

min_evidence.description: Weakest evidence accepted for filtered facts: inferred (default) < declared (by developer) < tested (by us).

min_graphics_polish.description: Only games whose graphics polish score is known and at least this (0–5; 3 = decent, consistent style; 4 = polished; 5 = outstanding). Scores are inferred from screenshots.

min_rating.description: Only games whose average player rating (1-5 stars, one decimal) is at least this. Games with fewer than 3 ratings have no public rating and never match. Ratings are player opinions, not verified facts.

no_ads.description: true = only games known to show no ads.

no_download.description: true = only games known to play in the browser without a download/install.

no_signup.description: true = only games known to be playable without creating an account.

offline_play.description: true = only games known to work offline after loading.

pace.description: relaxed = "take your time": no clock or opponent rushing you (most puzzles, turn-based, solitaire-like); timed = reflexes or speed decide (arcade, real-time).

player_modes.description: Game must support ALL of these modes. "same_device_multiplayer" = local multiplayer on one device.

publisher.description: Only games listed under this publisher id (as returned in a game's publisher.id).

query.description: Free-text preference, e.g. "relaxing space puzzle". Matched against title, genres, themes, keywords and description.

session_length.description: short = a session fits in ~5 minutes; medium = 5–20; long = 20+.

subgenres.description: Match games having ANY of these sub-genres (the distributor's finer categories, e.g. hidden-object, match-3, tower-defense, jigsaw-puzzles).

themes.description: Match games having ANY of these themes (setting/subject, e.g. fantasy = fantasy/epic, sci_fi = sci-fi/space, war = war/military, ocean = sea/pirates).

tones.description: Match games having ANY of these tones/moods (funny, cute = cute/cozy, relaxing, scary, intense = intense/competitive, serious = serious/realistic...).

name: search_games

rating_avg.description: Average player rating 1-5 (one decimal); null below 3 ratings. Opinion, not a verified fact.

rating_count.description: Number of player ratings; null below 3.

tag_relevance.description: When filtering by genres, art_styles, themes or tones: how strongly the game has the requested tag, 0-100 (results are ordered by it); null otherwise.

unknown_matches.description: Games whose filtered facts are unknown. NOT matches.
